# 🧩 Agentail 0.0.3: Qoder, and Claude usage from VS Code

## 🆕 What's new

**Qoder**
- 🧩 **Qoder CLI and Qoder IDE** sessions now show up in the panel, in their own "Qoder" group with
  the Qoder icon: working, your turn, needs permission (with the command it wants to run), ended.
  The China edition (`~/.qoder-cn`) appears as "Qoder CN".
- Works on your SSH servers too: run `agentail add-host <server>` again to add Qoder's hooks there.
- Tested with qodercli 1.1.68 and Qoder IDE 1.1.66; the China edition is set up the same way but
  has not been tried with a real session yet.

**Claude usage everywhere**
- 📊 The Claude Code usage card now also updates when you use Claude Code in VS Code or Claude
  Desktop. Agentail asks Anthropic's usage endpoint (the numbers `/usage` shows) with Claude
  Code's own login, shortly after a Claude turn ends and when you open the panel, at most once a
  minute. The token is sent only to `api.anthropic.com` and never stored or logged.
  `agentail usage-api off` turns this off.

**Upgrading**
- Installing 0.0.3 over 0.0.2 sets up the Qoder hooks by itself if Qoder is installed
  (`~/.qoder` exists); your Claude and Codex settings are not touched. Log out and back in once
  (on X11: Alt+F2, `r`, Enter) so GNOME Shell loads the new panel.

## 🗓️ Next

Qwen Code and Gemini CLI are planned for 0.0.4.
